_doc: Tracked flag combinations. The daily job counts each one exactly (unsampled) per key per day and appends to data/daily_key_counts.csv. status: live = TT exists in Dataswan; candidate = drafted, not created; Add new combos from the discovery scan here. The FIRST flag of each combo is the pre-filter anchor in 03_track_exact_day.sql: it is matched against SUSPICION_FLAGS and TELLTALE_LIST_AT_ALL_EVENTS and should be the rarest one.

combos.action_detail: Weekend, Oct 16-18: NOT mitigated. Adobe ARP grew to 959k (Oct 16), 1.42M (Oct 17) and 902k (Oct 18), with 59-75% verified. The TT fires, but most of the traffic still gets through. It peaked at 168k/h on Oct 18 12:00 UTC (83% verified) and was down to ~3-4k/h by midnight. This is the top ask: change the action on this key. New keys: WBD Account Lookup (Key 20) 435k on Oct 18 (23% verified; bursts at 06h, 08-09h and 18-20h with a 188k/h peak). WBD Login (Key 8) 203k on Oct 18 (39% verified; 40k/h at 18h and 54k/h at 21-22h). Olo Payments 10k (5% verified, still running). Roblox Signup is steady at ~40k/day.
